title: Limited image-specific inductive bias compared to CNNs
description: Vision Transformer has much less image-specific inductive bias than CNNs. It lacks built-in translation equivariance, locality, and two-dimensional neighborhood structure. Only MLP layers are local and translationally equivariant, while self-attention layers are global. As a result, ViT does not generalize well when trained on insufficient amounts of data.
